name: The Christmas Dinner That Keeps Getting Bigger: Interactive ESL Mystery
description_short: An interactive choose-your-path Christmas mystery for A2–B1 learners (about ages 11–15), for screens: students read, choose between two options at each decision point and find one of five endings (49 routes), then examine a 12-card Case File and try five follow-up activities. About 45 minutes. PDF, 42 pages, $4.99 on Payhip.
creator: GapTheMind
